# dsh-superagent

> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

## Setup

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

## Documentation

Read the numbered documents in order; each builds only on the ones before it.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source

## Development

`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.

Craft Anything

English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 한국어

See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version; an open-source, clean-room engine in pure Rust.
Point it at a target, say what you want, and it studies the original with real inspection tools,
has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original and refines it.

Download Craft Anything · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



A website project: each check says how alike the build is, you approve anything outside the rules, and the plan shows what's left.

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers, > filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil > last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

How it works · Two ways to use it · AI · Agents · Under the hood · Get started · Status · Downloads · Discord


🔍 Study anything

Websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files: real inspection tools find out how they're built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.

🛠️ Build your own

Say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.

✅ Checked, not guessed

Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it's close.

🤖 Agent-ready

314 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.

## How it works Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps, asking you in plain words when a decision is yours: 1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs. 2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your request names (or a sensible default). 3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet. 4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
## Two ways to use it - **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it, press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom. "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode). - **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C, disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console. Both modes drive the same engine. ## Clean room or Deep - **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened) and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused and say how to turn on Deep mode. - **Deep**: every tool is used, for your private use. A program's code and files are read with the built-in engines (and Ghidra when it's installed), a website's JavaScript is read and its start page watched, and the builder may use all of them. Switch in the title bar or Settings, with `settings_set deep_mode true`, or for one CLI run with `--deep` (or `--clean-room`).


Advanced: functions, pseudo-C, the agent and the evidence behind every answer.

## AI Building needs a coding agent on your computer. **Claude Code** is supported first: Craft Anything runs your own, unmodified `claude` program, which uses your own sign-in; Craft Anything never sees or handles your account. Your use of it falls under your own agreement with Anthropic. See [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md) for how and why. A Codex adapter exists but hasn't been verified on a real install yet. Other agents that speak ACP (Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, opencode, goose, Hermes, Maki) can be switched to it per backend; of those, only Maki has been run live. Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter and local OpenAI-compatible servers are available for questions and analysis (Settings → AI). ## Built for agents Every tool is also a CLI subcommand and an MCP tool, so an agent can study a target or run a whole rebuild without the app: ```sh craft-anything-cli commands # every tool, by toolset craft-anything-cli mcp # serve them to any MCP client craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" ``` Results are evidence records with their confidence, coverage and limitations; big ones come back as a summary first and are paged with `core_evidence_browse`. `craft-anything-cli setup` connects Craft Anything to coding-agent apps. ## Under the hood A pure-Rust reverse-engineering engine with 314 tools (298 in the engine, the rest from the AI and setup layers) for native programs, .NET, Java, Android, Apple, Electron/JavaScript, websites, firmware, packet captures, databases and game files. Its own decoders, disassembler and decompiler work without any outside program; Deep mode uses them all, and Ghidra when it's installed. It powers the desktop app (egui), the CLI and the MCP server, and parts of it run in the browser as WebAssembly. The full list is in [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md). ## Get started Requires Rust **1.97 or newer** (a dependency needs it; `rustup update`). On Debian or Ubuntu, the desktop app also needs: ```sh sudo apt-get install libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev libx11-dev libxrandr-dev libxi-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libgtk-3-dev ``` Then: ```sh git clone https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything && cd craft-anything cargo run --release -p craft-anything # the desktop app cargo install --path apps/craft-anything-cli # the CLI, as `craft-anything-cli` craft-anything-cli doctor # checks the install, coding agents and engines ``` Building needs a coding agent signed in on your computer (see [AI](#ai)); `doctor` says what's missing. Rebuild from the command line (questions are asked in the terminal): ```sh craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "A snake game in Rust" --rounds 1 craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Make the header blue" --continue-in "" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "Add a contact form" --project-folder "" --existing edit ``` New projects go in `Documents/Craft Anything` (change it in Settings → General). Each project folder holds `craft.json` (the request, target, status and history), `capture/` (what was recorded from the target), `app/` (the generated project), `checks/` (each comparison against the original), `investigation.cany/` (evidence) and `inbox/` (open questions). A project can also start in a folder you pick (Choose a folder… under Start, or `--project-folder`). If it already has files, you say what they are: the app itself, which the builder edits in place, or material to start from, with the app built in `app/` beside them (Settings → General can remember the answer). Settings → General also lists projects from more folders; removing one only takes it off the list. ## Status > [!IMPORTANT] > **Status:** Craft Anything is in early alpha. What works today, what is partial and what's next: > > - **Works today:** the desktop app (Simple and Advanced), the CLI and the MCP server; the > Study → Build → Check → Refine workflow for websites, apps and games with Claude Code as the > builder; website checks at three screen widths; game rebuilds in Unity, Unreal or Godot; Deep > mode with Ghidra; generated pictures and 3D models (opt-in, your own fal.ai key); plugins (MCP > servers, and WASM components in builds with the `wasm-plugins` option). > - **Partly there:** building with API keys and other coding agents (built, not yet run live), > behaviour checks for apps and games, a few engine tools tested only against stand-ins. > - **Next:** the first public release (installers for Windows, macOS, Linux and FreeBSD, and the > browser viewer are set up in CI), then the managed tier. > > [docs/STATUS.md](docs/STATUS.md) has the detail and how each part was checked, > [docs/tool-status.md](docs/tool-status.md) the tool-by-tool checklist, and > [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md) the plan, item by item. Please file issues, or tell us what > broke on [Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft). **Responsible use.** Use Craft Anything on software you own or are allowed to examine. It never bypasses DRM, logins or anti-cheat. Rebuilds recreate layout, style and behaviour from evidence; the agent is told not to copy logos, photos or text unless you confirm you own them or have permission. ## Downloads On GitHub, the [latest release](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/latest) has every build listed below, and [all releases](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases) has earlier versions and their notes. `` in the file names is the version number, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file. ### Windows | Build | Installer | Portable | |---|---|---| | x64 (64-bit Intel/AMD) | `craft-anything--windows-x64.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-x64-portable.zip` | | arm64 (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs) | `craft-anything--windows-arm64.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-arm64-portable.zip` | | x86 (32-bit) | `craft-anything--windows-x86.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-x86-portable.zip` | Installers and executables are code-signed. The portable zip keeps its settings next to the app. ### macOS | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | App, universal (Apple silicon + Intel) | `craft-anything--macos-universal.dmg` | Signed and notarized | | Command-line tool, universal | `craft-anything-cli--macos-universal.zip` | Signed and notarized; see below if macOS blocks it | Versions after 0.2.0 include the command-line tool in the app, so builds don't need the separate zip. You only need it to use the command line without the app. A browser download of the zip can stop with "Apple could not verify craft-anything-cli" (a lone program can't carry its notarization with it, so macOS has to look it up online). A download from the terminal isn't checked this way, so use this instead: ```sh ver=0.2.0 # change this to the version you want curl -fLO "https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/download/v$ver/craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal.zip" ditto -x -k "craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal.zip" . mkdir -p ~/.local/bin mv "craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal/craft-anything-cli" ~/.local/bin/ ~/.local/bin/craft-anything-cli --version ``` To run it as just `craft-anything-cli`, add `~/.local/bin` to your `PATH`. If you already have the blocked copy, press Done (not Move to Bin), then run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine `, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. ### Linux | Format | x86_64 | aarch64 (ARM64) | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | AppImage | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.AppImage` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.AppImage` | Runs anywhere; updates itself with [AppImageUpdate](https://github.com/AppImageCommunity/AppImageUpdate) (`.zsync` files) | | Flatpak | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.flatpak` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.flatpak` | Sandboxed; `flatpak install --user ` | | Debian/Ubuntu | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.deb` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.deb` | | | Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.rpm` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.rpm` | | | Tarball | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Unpack anywhere | RISC-V (riscv64): `craft-anything--linux-riscv64.tar.gz`, a tarball only. ### FreeBSD | Build | File | |---|---| | x86_64 | `craft-anything--freebsd-x86_64.tar.gz` | ### Web (WebAssembly) | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | Browser viewer | `craft-anything-web-.zip` | Says what a file is, in the browser (the file never leaves it); host the folder on any static web server ([packaging/web/README.md](packaging/web/README.md)) |

# Agent Autoloop **让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。** **中文** | [English](README.en.md) [上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档) ![架构图](docs/architecture.svg) ## 它解决什么问题？ 平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。 **Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。 - **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。 - **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。 - **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。 ## 上手 支持 macOS 和 Linux。运行前需要装好 Node 24、Git、curl，以及任意一个你已经登录好的命令行 Agent，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以直接把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)丢给你的 Agent，让它替你装好。 > **Windows 版：待定。** 很多朋友在问 Windows 版，我都看到了。我现在人在外面出差，手边没有 Windows 电脑，没法真机开发和测试，所以现在还不能在 Windows 上用。这个周末（11 月 7、8 日）回家后，我会把它开发完，做完兼容性测试，再正式推出。进度会更新在 [#17](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/issues/17)。 ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh ``` 装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”： ```bash agent-autoloop try ``` 下面是在终端里的真实输出： ```text 事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活…… Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。 【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色 这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。 1. 蓝色 2. 绿色 回答：agent-autoloop answer 1 <序号> 答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。 ``` 交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。 ## 一件事怎么转起来 编号和上面的架构图一一对应： 1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。 2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。 3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。 4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。 5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。 能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。 ## 日常怎么配？ ### 写一份规则（`rules.json`） 不需要写胶水代码。打开 `~/.agent-autoloop/rules.json`，在 `rules` 里写清楚**什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干**。`to` 填 `agents` 里已有的名字。比如每天早上 9 点写早报： ```json { "name": "早报", "when": { "cron": "0 9 * * *" }, "to": "codex", "cwd": "~/notes", "prompt": "整理昨天的笔记和提交，写今天的早报。" } ``` 外部事件写法一样，只是要先接好来源。比如有人提新 Issue 时交给 Codex，先按[说明](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#接一个事件插件)在 `sources` 里登记 `github`： ```json { "name": "处理 issue", "when": { "source": "github", "types": ["issues.opened"] }, "to": "codex", "cwd": "~/code/app", "skill": "handle-issue", "parallel": 3 } ``` 保存后几秒内自动生效，可以运行 `agent-autoloop check` 检查。就算改错了，或者文件被删、读不到，系统也会继续按旧规则跑，并发卡片提醒你。 ### Agent 怎么跟中台配合？ 中台对 Agent 只有一个约定：**在最后一条回复里交代结果**。事情办完了，正常输出一句结论就行。需要向你请示时，在回复末尾附一段 `agent-autoloop` 代码块： ````text 订单已经核对完毕，库存充足。 ```agent-autoloop { "ask": [{ "title": "怎么发货？", "text": "两种方式今天都能发出。", "options": ["快递", "自提"], "key": "shipping" }] } ``` ```` 除了提问（`ask`），还能发通知（`notice`）、关闭已解决的卡片（`resolve`）、预约复查（`later`）和触发新事件（`events`）。通告不需要回答，但结案时可以顺手写一句处理说明，这句话会留在卡片上。万一 JSON 写错了，中台只让它在原会话里重写最后这段回复，不会把已经干完的业务重做一遍；重写也失败时，保留原结论并通知你回执没有生效。接着旧会话跑也一样：会话接不上才开新的；接上了、干到一半断了，就算没跑成，过几分钟回到原会话重试，不开新会话重做。 ## 拿来即用的场景模板 每套模板都带规则、任务 Skill 和启用说明。 | 想做什么 | 已经封装好的流程 | |---|---| | {prompt}` | | [WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy](https://www.codebuddy.ai/docs/cli/headless) | `codebuddy -p {prompt}` | **交付流水线。** 给 GitHub PR 打上 `deliver` 标签后，它会自己跟进到上线：**审代码 → 等 CI → 合并 PR → 等部署 → [Agent](examples/plugins/hello-agent/agent.ts)、[通道](examples/plugins/hello-channel/channel.ts)、[事件](examples/plugins/hello-source/source.ts) 三个可运行的最小模板开始，见[插件开发说明](docs/plugins.md)。要让 Agent 行代码、零运行时依赖。它不读系统时钟、不用随机数、不向外发请求，插件主动连进来，账号凭据留在各自的插件里；同样的输入永远得出同样的结果。它把四个计算机领域的成熟做法用到了命令行 Agent 上： - **挂起零消耗**：等你拍板时进程直接退出，等待状态存在数据库里，Agent 不用一直挂着。你三天没回，这三天就没有 Agent 进程在跑、不花 Token，只有很轻的中台在后台等着；你一回答，它接着原来的对话继续干。 - **事件溯源**：所有状态都从一条只追加的日志算出来，日志和索引在同一个事务里写进磁盘，写完才应答。进程被强杀，已经确认的事不丢（整机断电没有单独测过）；任何一轮为什么跑、结果是什么，一条命令就能查清；数据格式变了就从日志重建，不用写迁移脚本。 - **指令数据分离**：思路和 SQL 参数化一样。Issue 的标题和正文等外部文字只作为资料放进文件，不拼进提示词，提示词里只有校验过字符的类型、编号和链接；用哪个 Agent、在哪个目录、什么权限，只由你本机的规则决定，事件里带 `cwd`、`agent`、`access` 字段会被直接拒收。 - **跳数熔断**：思路和网络包的 TTL 一样。Agent 交回的事件会再派给 Agent，层数一路累加，经过人工提问和定时复查也不清零，Agent 自己改不了；超过 8 层就只记录、不再派活，并发一张卡片告诉你。 ### 自己跑一遍 在程序目录 `~/.agent-autoloop/app` 下运行： | 验证什么 | 命令 | |---|---| | 任何一轮的来龙去脉 | `agent-autoloop why 1` | | 20 万步模拟断网、丢包、崩溃和重复提交，一个种子就能复现 | `node sim/random.ts 24301 200000` | | 强杀进程 1000 次，已确认的记录一条不丢 | `node sim/crash.ts 1000 12648430` | | 下面的性能数字 | `npm run benchmark` | ```text 第 1 轮 · 演示 11-03 20:47:25 规则版本 #1 11-03 20:47:25 触发事件：来源 local · 类型 demo.start · 对象 example 11-03 20:47:25 local 领取（演示程序） 11-03 20:47:25 结束：演示完成 ``` ### 实测性能 Apple M5 Pro、24 GB、Node 24.21.0。写入逐条提交，事务落盘后才应答。`npm run benchmark` 的达标线按这台机器定，换台机器可能报未达标。 | 指标 | 实测 | |---|---:| | 冷启动 | 88.78 ms | | 空闲内存 | 59.94 MB RSS | | 1000 个同时等待的长轮询 | 170.49 MB RSS | | 持久化写入 | 2394 条/秒 | | 派活 p99 | 1.82 ms | | 排队 5000 时被挡下的心跳 p99 | 1.66 ms | | 110 万条事实时的启动 | 99.8 ms | | 内核行数（含空行和注释） | 1651 | | 运行时依赖 | 0 | 历史变大后，状态汇总会变慢，日志和索引也继续占磁盘；格式变化后的首次启动要从日志全量重建，110 万条用时 43.1 秒。[完整数据和测法](docs/protocol.md#历史增长实测)。 ## 用量与合规说明 中台直接调用你本机已经安装并登录好的命令行工具，不会读取或转存你的账号凭据。模型调用消耗算在你自己的账号名下，额度和使用范围遵循各家模型厂商的服务条款。 # NOIR

[![build](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Verlintas/NOIR)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Verlintas/NOIR)](LICENSE)
![platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-macOS%20%7C%20Windows%20%7C%20Linux-2ea44f)
[![AtomGit](https://img.shields.io/badge/AtomGit-Verlintas%2FNOIR-2f81f7)](https://atomgit.com/Verlintas/NOIR)

**把「这台手机到底能泄露什么」变成一份可复现的报告。**

NOIR 是一个跑在电脑上的审计工具，通过 `adb` 读取已连接 Android 设备的应用清单、权限和 APK 里的网络端点，给出分类、风险评分和可执行的处置建议。它也可以在需要时调用 `jadx` 对单个应用做反编译和关键字检索。

> 定位：**审计与自我防护**。面向自己的设备、自己的应用、已授权的安全研究。

**官网 / Website:** https://verlintas.dev/noir/ · [中文](https://verlintas.dev/noir/zh/)

**AtomGit 镜像 / Mirror:** https://atomgit.com/Verlintas/NOIR

---

## 它做什么

1. **盘点**：列出所有「有网络权限 + 敏感权限」的应用，以及它们各自拿到了什么。
2. **抽取端点**：在设备端用 `unzip + strings` 从每个 APK 的 dex 里提取 URL，只回传几 KB，不把整包拉回电脑。
3. **分类与打分**：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。
4. **数据关联**：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。
5. **共享 UID**：识别 `android.uid.system` 这类共享用户，列出哪些包实际上共享同一套权限并集。
6. **清单层**：解析 `AndroidManifest.xml` 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。
4. **给建议**：区分「可安全自动执行」「需人工确认」「不建议动」，并为每条动作生成回滚命令。
5. **必要时深挖**：`deep` 会把单个 APK 拉到本地，用 `jadx` 反编译后检索 `Runtime.exec`、`setApplicationEnabledSetting`、`DexClassLoader`、`MediaProjection` 等高风险调用。

## 它不做什么

- 不联网、不上传任何数据、不需要账号。
- 不修改系统分区，不需要 root。
- 不会自动卸载任何东西，除非你显式加 `--aggressive`。

---

## 第一次运行

```bash
noir
```

不带参数会进入向导：

1. 检查 `adb`，没有就**问你要不要自动下载**（`~/.noir/tools`）
2. 检查设备，没有就打印**开发者模式 / USB 调试的开通步骤**，然后**等你插线**（最多 180 秒）
3. 问一句「开始扫描?」，扫完直接出仪表盘
4. 问一句「执行这 19 条安全处置?」，`y` 就执行，并写好回滚文件

全程只会问两三个 y/n，其余都是自动的。

## 环境自检

```bash
noir doctor
```

```

  java      17.0.19
  adb       /opt/homebrew/.../platform-tools/adb
            Version 37.0.1-15733141
  device    178b0d2f  device  2509FPN0BC
  jadx      /opt/homebrew/bin/jadx
```

```bash
noir setup          # 缺什么下什么
noir setup --yes    # 不询问，适合脚本
```

## 出现问题时

所有错误都会带「怎么办」，而不是抛异常栈：

```
╭─ ERROR ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ 指定的 adb 不存在：/nonexistent/adb                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 检查路径，或运行 noir setup 自动安装。                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

没有设备时给出的是可执行步骤：

```
╭─ 没有检测到设备 ──────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│  1. 打开开发者模式                                           │
│     小米 / HyperOS：设置 → 我的设备 → 全部参数 → 连点「MIUI 版本」7 次
│  2. 开启 USB 调试：设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项 → USB 调试        │
│  3. 插线后手机弹「允许 USB 调试吗？」→ 勾选「一律允许」        │
│  4. 还不行就换一根数据线（很多线只能充电）                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

已连接但没授权时，会单独提示「撤销 USB 调试授权后重插」。

## 支持平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| macOS (Intel / Apple Silicon) | ✅ |
| Windows 10 / 11 | ✅ |
| Debian / Ubuntu | ✅ |

依赖：

- **JDK 17+**
- **Android platform-tools**（`adb`）
- **jadx**（仅 `deep` 命令需要）

程序会自动在常见安装位置查找 `adb` 和 `jadx`；找不到时可以用 `--adb` / `--jadx` 指定。

```bash
# macOS
brew install --cask android-platform-tools jadx

# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo apt install adb
# jadx: https://github.com/skylot/jadx/releases

# Windows (scoop)
scoop install adb jadx
```

---

## 安装

**方式一：下载即用（推荐）**

到 [Releases](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/releases) 下载对应平台的 portable 包：

```
noir-v0.1.1-macOS-portable.zip
noir-v0.1.1-Windows-portable.zip
noir-v0.1.1-Linux-portable.zip
SHA256SUMS.txt
```

解压后**双击启动器**即可，包内自带运行时，**不需要安装 Java**：

| 系统 | 双击这个 | 如果被拦 |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | `Start NOIR.command` | 右键 → 打开；或 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "Start NOIR.command" NOIR.app` |
| Windows | `Start NOIR.bat` | SmartScreen → 更多信息 → 仍要运行（批处理会切到 UTF-8 并调用包内 JRE） |
| Linux | `Start-NOIR.sh` | 先 `chmod +x Start-NOIR.sh`，或在终端执行 |

启动器会打开一个终端窗口跑完向导，并在结束时停住（不会一闪而过）。

`adb` 和 `jadx` 不在包里——首次运行会询问是否自动下载到 `~/.noir/tools`。

**方式二：从源码构建**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR
cd NOIR
./gradlew :cli:installDist
./cli/build/install/noir/bin/noir --about
```

## 构建

```bash
git clone <repo> && cd NOIR
./gradlew :cli:installDist
```

产物：

```
cli/build/install/noir/bin/noir        # macOS / Linux
cli/build/install/noir/bin/noir.bat    # Windows
```

也可以直接：

```bash
./gradlew :cli:run --args="devices"
```

---

## 界面

![NOIR dashboard on a Xiaomi 17 Pro Max](docs/screenshot.png)

真机输出（macOS Terminal）：渐变 logo、CJK 对齐的表格、按风险着色的分数、
每处理完一个 APK 就刷新一次的进度条。

`noir ui` 会把结果渲染成一块等宽仪表盘；颜色和边框都会按终端能力自动降级：

- `--ascii`：纯 ASCII 边框，给旧版 Windows 控制台
- `--no-color` / `--color`：关闭或强制 ANSI 颜色（默认按是否为 TTY 自动判断）
- `--quiet`：只留仪表盘，不打印扫描过程
- `--no-clear`：不清屏（方便把输出重定向到文件）

## 用法

```bash
noir --about              # 它是什么、会写什么、许可
noir --version
noir devices
noir scan                 # 全量扫描，输出 JSON / Markdown / 域名清单
noir ui                   # 扫描并渲染仪表盘
noir auto                 # 扫描 + 分类 + 生成处置计划（dry-run）
noir auto --apply         # 执行安全的 appops 动作（可回滚）
noir auto --apply --aggressive   # 额外卸载被标记的用户应用
noir deep com.example.app # 拉包 + jadx + 关键字检索
noir block com.example.app        # 打印处置命令
noir block com.example.app --apply
```

常用参数：

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `--serial <id>` | 指定设备 |
| `--out <dir>` | 输出目录（默认 `noir-out`） |
| `--min <score>` | 只保留分数 ≥ N 的应用 |
| `--limit <n>` | 最多输出 N 条 |
| `--only <regex>` | 只扫描匹配的包名，例如 `--only 'com\.miui\.'` |
| `--adb <path>` / `--jadx <path>` | 手动指定工具路径 |
| `--yes` | 自动化场景下跳过确认 |

## DeepScan：一条命令反编译 + 处置

```bash
noir deepscan                  # 反编译风险最高的 15 个应用
noir deepscan --top 30         # 更多
noir deepscan --all            # 全部被标记应用（慢，占磁盘）
noir deepscan --jobs 4         # 并行 jadx 数量
```

流程是：扫描 → 按风险排序 → 逐个 `adb pull` + `jadx` → 统计代码级信号
（`Runtime.exec`、`DexClassLoader`、`setApplicationEnabledSetting`、
`enabled_accessibility_services`、`MediaProjection`、`SystemProperties.set`、
短信/设备标识、WebView 桥、无障碍/通知监听/设备管理员 …）→ 解析清单
（导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable）→ 识别 SDK（Umeng/Firebase/AppsFlyer…）
→ 输出 `deepscan.md` / `deepscan.tsv` → 询问是否清理。

```bash
noir deepscan --apply          # 分析后执行安全 appops
noir deepscan --apply --purge  # 再逐个确认卸载高风险用户应用
```

反编译结果按 `包名 + APK 路径` 缓存，第二次跑同一个应用会直接复用。

## 输出

```
noir-out/
├── report.json               # 结构化结果（应用、权限、端点、建议）
├── report.md                 # 人类可读报告
├── domains-trackers.txt      # 统计/广告/崩溃上报，可整份导入
├── domains-other.txt         # 用途不明，导入前逐条判断
├── domains-functional.txt    # 推送/登录/更新/支付/商店/云同步，禁止拦截
├── domains.txt               # 等于 trackers（兼容旧脚本）
├── plan.txt                  # 本次可执行的 appops
└── rollback.txt              # 回滚命令
```

## 隐私

- 工具本身**不联网**：没有遥测、没有版本检查、没有崩溃上报
- 扫描结果只写在你指定的 `--out` 目录
- 唯一的外部请求发生在 `noir setup`（下载 adb/jadx）和 `noir deep`（jadx 是本地进程）
- 报告里可能包含你设备上的包名和端点，分享前自行检查

## 缓存

扫描结果按 `包名 + APK 路径` 缓存在 `~/.noir/endpoints.tsv`。应用更新后路径变化会自动重新分析，重复扫描通常只需几秒。

---

## 架构

```
adb ──▶ pm / dumpsys ──▶ Dumpsys parser ──┐
                                          ├─▶ cache (pkg + apk path)
adb ──▶ unzip/strings ──▶ endpoints ──────┘        │
                                                   ▼
                                          Classifier ─▶ score ─▶ Advisor
                                                   │              │
                                                   ▼              ▼
                                              report.json    plan.txt
                                              report.md      rollback.txt
                                                   │
                                                   ▼
                                                 Tui / CLI
```

`deep` 走另一条支线：`adb pull` → `jadx` → 源码 grep。

## 设计取舍

- **端点抽取在设备端完成**：`adb shell` 内跑 `unzip | strings | grep`，避免把几百个 APK 拉回电脑。设备缺少 `unzip`/`strings` 时自动退化为本地解析。
- **共享 UID 特殊处理**：Android 上 `android.uid.system` 下的应用（常见 50+ 个）权限记录在 `dumpsys package` 尾部的 `Shared users` 段。解析器会把这些权限合并回每个包，否则最该被看见的应用反而会消失。
- **建议分级**：只有 appops 级别的动作标记为可自动执行；卸载必须显式开启。
- **无遥测**：程序不包含任何上报逻辑。

## 常见问题

**需要 root 吗？**
不需要。全部通过 `adb` 的 shell 权限完成；卸载只是 `--user 0` 级别，APK 仍在系统分区。

**会改坏手机吗？**
默认完全只读。`--apply` 只改 app-ops，每条都能用 `default` 还原，`rollback.txt` 会写出来。
`noir block` 的卸载也会先打印 `pm install-existing` 的恢复命令。

**为什么有些应用只给"人工复核"？**
系统应用不能真正卸载（`--user 0` 卸载也会被 OTA 或恢复出厂装回来），所以只建议
app-ops 或 DNS 层拦截。

**DNS 拦截为什么只导出不执行？**
跨平台改 DNS 很容易把设备网断掉（我们在开发中踩过），所以只导出清单：

- `domains-trackers.txt` —— 统计/广告/崩溃上报，可以整份导入
- `domains-other.txt` —— 用途不明，导入前逐条判断
- `domains-functional.txt` —— 推送、登录、更新、支付、应用商店、云同步，**拦了会掉功能**
- `domains.txt` —— 现在只包含 trackers，兼容旧脚本

IP、`localhost` 和带 `test`/`staging` 的域名会被自动剔除。

**支持 iOS 吗？**
不支持。`core` 是按 Kotlin Multiplatform 组织的，但审计逻辑依赖 Android 的
`dumpsys` 和 APK 格式。

## 参与

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — 构建、测试、规则放在哪
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — 漏洞报告方式（请不要开公开 issue）
- [Issues](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/issues) — bug 请附上 `noir doctor` 输出

## 路线图

- [x] 等宽仪表盘（`noir ui`）
- [x] DeepScan（批量反编译 + 代码级信号）
- [x] 自带运行时的双击即用包（jpackage）
- [ ] 图形界面（Compose Multiplatform）
- [ ] 规则文件可配置（YAML），支持社区规则包
- [ ] 与 `apktool` / `jadx` 的批量流水线
- [ ] 设备端 DNS/VPN 拦截方案导出
- [ ] 扫描结果签名与版本对比

## 免责声明

NOIR 只应用于**你自己的设备**，或你获得明确授权的设备。它给出的是静态证据
（"这个应用具备这个能力，并且代码里有这个端点"），**不能证明**某次具体传输发生过。
请结合网络层证据自行判断。

items.readme: # terminal-mac [![](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=Sponsor&message=%E2%9D%A4&logo=GitHub&color=%23fe8e86)](https://github.com/sponsors/govijr) A separate macOS desktop for computer-use agents, viewed and controlled from a terminal. `terminal-mac` is an early release candidate for Apple silicon. Apple Virtualization runs a real macOS guest. A bundled helper **inside that guest** captures its screen and posts input events. A terminal viewer streams that screen using Kitty or iTerm2 graphics. Agent commands use the same helper without moving the physical Mac's pointer or changing its clipboard. The guest is a separate Mac: it has its own apps, files, accounts and permissions. It does not inherit your running host apps or signed-in sessions. The VM still consumes host CPU, memory and storage. ## Requirements - Apple silicon Mac, macOS 14 or later. - No development tools are needed for a prebuilt release. Maintainers need Xcode 16 or later / Swift 6 to build. - Internet on first run to download macOS directly from Apple, or an existing compatible `.ipsw`. - Space for the cached restore image and a growing VM disk (64 GiB logical size by default). - Ghostty, Kitty or iTerm2 for the inline viewer. Other terminals can use the native VM window and agent CLI. tmux passthrough and automatic terminal splits are not implemented. ## Install and run ```sh curl -fsSL https://github.com/govijr/terminal-mac/releases/latest/download/get.sh | bash ``` The installer downloads the latest release and verifies its SHA-256 before installing. You can also extract a release ZIP and run `bash install.sh` from it. The installer places one launcher in `~/.local/bin` and the bundled runtime under `~/.local/lib/terminal-mac`. Add `~/.local/bin` to your PATH to use simply `terminal-mac`. It needs no administrator rights and does not edit your shell configuration. `bash install.sh --prefix /absolute/path` selects another location. Running `terminal-mac` in an interactive terminal starts the guided flow. `terminal-mac up` does the same explicitly. It automatically downloads/caches a compatible Apple restore image, installs a virtual Mac, boots it and checks the guest helper. Later runs reuse the existing VM and reconnect. Unsupported terminals get the native desktop window. **Current status:** early release candidate. Releases are self-signed (no Apple notarization), which the curl installer doesn't need. Live guest acceptance on a clean Mac is still pending. ## Use with agents terminal-mac gives agents computer use in a separate virtual Mac, through MCP tools (`screenshot`, `click`, `drag`, `scroll`, `type`, `key`, `status`) and a skill that teaches the observe → act → verify loop. **Claude Code**, with the MCP server and skill in one plugin: ```text /plugin install terminal-mac --marketplace govijr/terminal-mac ``` Or add them separately: ```sh claude mcp add terminal-mac -- terminal-mac mcp terminal-mac skills install # → ~/.claude/skills/terminal-mac/SKILL.md ``` **Other MCP clients** (Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Windsurf…): paste the output of `terminal-mac mcp --config` into the client's MCP settings. Use `terminal-mac mcp NAME` for a VM other than `default`. **Any agent with a skills folder:** `terminal-mac skills install --dir PATH`, or `npx skills add govijr/terminal-mac --skill terminal-mac`. In an `AGENTS.md`, a line like "Before using the virtual Mac, run `terminal-mac skills get`" gives the agent instructions that match the installed version. The tools only drive the guest helper. They never touch your own desktop. When the guest is at its login screen, they say so, so the agent can ask you to sign in. ## One-time guest setup The first run opens the virtual Mac's window. Complete macOS setup and create its user account. Inside the guest, open Finder → `/Volumes/My Shared Files/tools` → `TerminalMacGuest.app` once. The helper installs itself in the guest's `~/Applications`, launches that installed copy and registers for future guest logins, subject to macOS approval. Use its two buttons to grant **Screen Recording** and **Accessibility** inside the guest. Reopen it if macOS asks. If needed, its **Guest Login Items** button opens the startup setting. The host needs neither privacy permission. Once both guest permissions are ready, the CLI automatically continues to the terminal desktop. This is guided setup, not an unattended guest installation. Apple documents automatic account provisioning for macOS 27 guests; this build targets the APIs available in the installed macOS 26 SDK and does not implement that newer flow. See [Apple's provisioning documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/virtualization/vzmacguestprovisioningoptions). ```sh terminal-mac up work # another virtual Mac terminal-mac up --ipsw /path/mac.ipsw # use a local image terminal-mac up --no-view # wait for agent readiness, then return JSON terminal-mac up --detach # install/boot, return without waiting for guest setup terminal-mac up --plan # show steps without network access or disk changes ``` The first download may take time; packaging cannot eliminate downloading and installing macOS. The image cache is reused, and URLSession resume data is retained after recoverable network failures. A hard process kill may require the current download to restart. An incomplete installation with recorded hardware can be retried by `up` using a compatible restore image; an already installed VM is never reinstalled by `up`. ## Build from source ```sh bash scripts/build.sh ./dist/terminal-mac doctor ``` The build creates `dist/TerminalMac.app`, including `TerminalMacGuest.app`, and the `dist/terminal-mac` launcher. Virtualization needs the host executable's `com.apple.security.virtualization` entitlement; use the packaged launcher instead of the unsigned Swift build product. It is signed with the self-signed "Govijr Code Signing" identity when your keychain has it (`bash scripts/create-signing-identity.sh` makes one), and ad-hoc otherwise. A stable identity keeps the guest helper's permissions across rebuilds; ad-hoc builds need them granted again. [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) covers signing and publishing. ## Create your first Mac ```sh # Show the URL and version without downloading anything: ./dist/terminal-mac image # Explicitly download Apple's latest supported restore image (several GB): ./dist/terminal-mac image --output /tmp/RestoreImage.ipsw # Install macOS. The disk is sparse, and the IPSW is not copied into the VM bundle. ./dist/terminal-mac create default --ipsw /tmp/RestoreImage.ipsw ./dist/terminal-mac start default --window ``` Complete macOS Setup Assistant in the VM window and create a guest account. Inside the guest: 1. Open Finder → `/Volumes/My Shared Files/tools`. 2. Open `TerminalMacGuest.app`. It installs itself to the guest's `~/Applications` and opens the installed copy. 3. Use the helper's buttons to grant **Screen Recording** and **Accessibility** in the guest's System Settings. Reopen the helper if macOS asks. The host does not need either permission. 4. Keep the guest logged in and the helper running. It registers itself for guest login; approve that setting if macOS requests it. On the host: ```sh ./dist/terminal-mac action default status ./dist/terminal-mac hide default ./dist/terminal-mac view default ``` The viewer supports typing, left/right clicks, double and triple clicks, dragging, scrolling, arrows and common control keys. **Ctrl+G** opens a palette of Mac shortcuts (Spotlight, Mission Control, copy/paste, close/quit and more), because terminals keep ⌘ for themselves. **Ctrl+]** exits the viewer while the VM keeps running. Closing the native VM window hides it and also leaves the VM running. The guest helper keeps a ScreenCaptureKit stream open while a viewer is watching. It sends a frame only when the screen changes (up to 30 fps), already sized to the pixels the terminal draws, as lossless lz4-compressed pixels. Kitty and Ghostty receive those frames through shared memory rather than the pty. An idle desktop costs nothing, and the stream stops 15 seconds after the viewer leaves. From build 4 on, the guest helper updates itself: within 30 seconds of a newer build appearing in the shared tools folder, it installs that build and relaunches. Helpers from build 3 and earlier still work but poll full screenshots, and the header shows "snapshots". Update those once by opening `/Volumes/My Shared Files/tools/TerminalMacGuest.app` in the guest. Releases are signed with one unchanging self-signed certificate, so the guest keeps its Screen Recording and Accessibility approvals across updates. Agents can drive the guest through an MCP server: `claude mcp add terminal-mac -- "$PWD/dist/terminal-mac" mcp default`. See [docs/AGENT.md](docs/AGENT.md). New VMs use a 2x HiDPI display (for example 2560×1600 pixels at 220 ppi for the default 1280×800 points), so text stays sharp on Retina terminals. Switch a stopped VM with `terminal-mac display default --hidpi` or `--standard`. The automounted volume is supplied by macOS virtio-fs. If it is absent, check the guest's macOS version and the VM log; this prototype has no fallback guest transport. ## Give an agent computer control ```sh ./dist/terminal-mac action default screenshot --output /tmp/guest.png ./dist/terminal-mac action default click 640 400 ./dist/terminal-mac action default type 'Hello from the agent' ./dist/terminal-mac action default key cmd+space ./dist/terminal-mac action default key return ./dist/terminal-mac action default scroll --dy -300 --x 640 --y 400 ``` Commands return JSON and a nonzero exit status on failure. Screenshots return a local host PNG path. Coordinates start at the top-left and match the screenshot's dimensions; screenshots use guest display points to keep input coordinates consistent on Retina displays. `snapshot` is currently a screenshot alias, not an accessibility-tree snapshot. The agent instructions are in [docs/AGENT.md](docs/AGENT.md). No global agent settings are modified. ## Lifecycle and resources ```sh ./dist/terminal-mac ls ./dist/terminal-mac status default ./dist/terminal-mac pause default ./dist/terminal-mac resume default ./dist/terminal-mac show default ./dist/terminal-mac stop default # request a normal guest shutdown ./dist/terminal-mac stop default --force # immediate power-off; unsaved guest work can be lost ``` Customize a new VM with `--cpus 4 --memory 4 --disk 64 --width 1280 --height 800` (width and height are in points; add `--standard` for a 1x display). CPU, memory and disk arguments are logical CPUs, GiB and GiB respectively. `--offline` omits the guest network device; the shared-folder control channel still works, though some macOS setup workflows may require networking. VM data lives in `~/Library/Application Support/terminal-mac/machines/NAME/`. `TERMINAL_MAC_HOME` overrides the data root. Each VM has an exclusive file lock, a sparse disk, hardware identity, auxiliary boot storage, `machine.json`, a private host-control mailbox, the guest exchange directory, and `runtime.log`. A VM boot runs as a separate background process. Lifecycle commands must use the same `TERMINAL_MAC_HOME` as the process that started it. An interrupted or failed installation leaves its directory and `installed: false` for diagnosis. It is never silently overwritten. To retry, ensure no installer/VM is running, move that incomplete directory aside, then create the VM again. There is deliberately no destructive VM-delete command yet. ## Isolation model - Host input and screen APIs are not used for agent actions. The helper refuses to run unless `hw.model` starts with `VirtualMac`. That check prevents accidental host execution; it is not hardware attestation or a defense against a compromised host. - The guest sees two explicit shares: `control` (read/write, containing request/reply JSON and screenshots) and `tools` (read-only helper app). Host home, project folders, clipboard, microphone, and camera are not attached. - There is no remote-control network listener. The flat mailbox pins its directory, rejects symlinks, hardlinks and nonregular files on reads, bounds message sizes, checks request IDs, and expires pending actions. The host never executes guest-provided content. - Default NAT networking permits guest internet access and may reach services on the host or local network. This is **not** a network-isolated or hardened hostile-code environment. `--offline` removes that network path. - A logged-out/locked guest, missing helper, denied guest permissions, or paused VM prevents normal computer use. TCC grants are interactive guest setup, not bypassed by the CLI. VM cloning, rollback checkpoints, accessibility snapshots, fully unattended guest setup, terminal splits and tmux transport remain future work. The native Virtualization framework does not itself render a Mac into a terminal or offer an agent input API; this project supplies the guest transport and terminal presentation layers. ## Development and validation ```sh CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/terminal-mac-modules \ SWIFTPM_MODULECACHE_OVERRIDE=/tmp/terminal-mac-modules \ swift test --disable-sandbox --scratch-path /tmp/terminal-mac-build \ --cache-path /tmp/terminal-mac-cache \ --config-path /tmp/terminal-mac-config --security-path /tmp/terminal-mac-security ``` Tests cover mailbox round trips, expiry and cleanup, file-boundary defenses, name/option validation, fragmented UTF-8 and terminal input sequences. These are automated protocol checks, not evidence that a guest was installed, booted, granted permissions, or controlled successfully. See [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md) for recorded results and the live checklist. References: [terminal-browser](https://terminal-browser.com/), [Apple's macOS virtualization sample](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/virtualization/running-macos-in-a-virtual-machine-on-apple-silicon), [VZVirtualMachineView](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/virtualization/vzvirtualmachineview), [ScreenCaptureKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/screencapturekit). ## Sponsor terminal-mac is free and maintained in my own time. items.readme:
# Claude Animated Shorts

The free Claude skill from the video **"How to Make Viral Animated Shorts Using Claude (Full Workflow)"**.

It makes 55-70 s vertical animated story shorts: 2D characters in a colourful 3D world, with ink outlines, a painted town, lens blur, gliding cameras, a march score and sound effects. Everything is rendered with three.js inside Remotion on your own PC, with no AI video generator.

Proven on **The Bridge That Fell for a Song**, a 67 s short about the 1831 Broughton bridge.

## What's inside
| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | The skill: the full pipeline, every rule, every fix, and the final look values |
| `templates/bridge/` | The full source of the bridge short: world, characters, ink, lens blur, grade, story/camera |
| `templates/audio/` | The synthesized sound: SFX, march music, the mix with ducking and loudness |
| `templates/scripts/` | Stills, side-by-side sheets, shot merge and frame-by-frame QA helpers |
| `references/STYLE_BIBLE.md` | The script and visual formula measured from 20 reference shorts |
| `references/reports/` | Seven measured reports: motion, depth, textures, characters, lighting, outlines, grade |
| `references/frames/` | 38 full-size reference frames (540x960) to compare your frames against |
| `references/sheets/` | 20 contact sheets, one per reference short, 60 frames each (1,200 frames) |

## Install
1. Copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/cartoon-3d-short/` (clone it there, or download the ZIP).
2. You need [Remotion](https://www.remotion.dev/) with `@remotion/three`, plus Node, Python 3 and ffmpeg.
3. In Claude Code, say: *"Use the cartoon short skill and make a short about …"*.

Claude then follows `SKILL.md`: topic and facts, then script, then voice, then the shot plan in `story.ts`, then stills, then renders. Agents check your frames against the reports and the frames, and you get the final 2K render and sound mix.

## Notes
- Set `REMOTION_TMP` to a folder on a big drive. Every Remotion bundle copies `public/` (~1.3 GB) into the temp folder.
- Story, characters and voice should always be your own. Use the references for the look, not the content.

## License
The code and docs are MIT (see `LICENSE`). The reference frames are included for style study only.

AI apps

AWS, with AWS's own icons

items.readme:
知了 · Cicada

任何会议、任何直播，没有语言障碍。
听得懂，说得出，记得住。Mac、Windows、Linux 和 Android 上的实时纪要、双语文字记录、字幕与同声传译。

 

简体中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어

无论是用 Zoom、飞书、腾讯会议开会，还是听 X Spaces 和 YouTube 直播，知了都能实时给出双语字幕、边听边写结构化纪要。遇到需要发言的时候，按住说话键（Mac 上是右 `⌥`，Windows 上是右 `Ctrl`）开口，对方就能在会里直接听到翻译好的语音。知了直接读取系统声音，不用往会里塞机器人，对方完全无感；在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上还全部在本机识别，声音不出电脑。

## 平台 | 平台 | 系统要求 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | Mac | macOS 14.4+，Apple 芯片 / Intel | 功能最全；Apple 芯片本机识别（不填 key 也能用），Intel 版需要 Ling key（识别走 Ming） | | Windows | Windows 10 2004+，x64 / ARM64 | 需要 Ling key（用不了 Ling 时可换 OpenRouter、ZenMux 等）；见 [windows/](windows/README.md) | | Linux | Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04 桌面版 | 需要 Ling 或其他 AI 服务的 key；纪要窗会被屏幕共享看到；见 [linux/](linux/README.md) | | Android | Android 10+ | 需要 Ling 或其他 AI 服务的 key；视频与直播字幕、面对面互译；见 [android/](android/README.md) | 四个平台共用一个版本号和同一种会议记录格式，安装包都在 [官网下载页](https://cicada.indaloop.app/download/) 和 [Releases](https://github.com/wquguru/cicada/releases)。下面的功能说明以 Mac 版为准。 ## 主要功能 ### 实时纪要与双语文字记录 开会时纪要窗口边听边整理总结、议题要点、结论、待办、鱼骨图和人名术语表，点一下结论或待办就能跳回双语文字记录里的原话。纪要会统一文中人名和术语的写法并记下听错的变体，按 `⌘F` 搜索时能连同识别错的写法一起搜出来。AI 服务出了只有你能修的问题（key、余额、模型）时，纪要窗口会说明，菜单栏图标多一个橙点；打开了麦克风却没拿到麦克风权限时，纪要窗口、字幕条和菜单栏图标都会提示。 ### 实时字幕与语言识别 对方开口几秒钟就能在本地自动认出语言并翻成你的系统语言，按 `⌃⌥S` 可以在纪要窗口、字幕条和不显示之间切换。字幕条只在有人说话时出现，鼠标划过时自动变透明，不会挡住底下的按钮。在 Apple 芯片的 macOS 26 上，文字记录还会在本机把会议再听一遍，每句话说完 15 到 30 秒后校准好：错字更少，字幕断句的地方也不再丢字，字幕本身照样快。 ### 线下会议 在会议室里开会时，点菜单栏面板或纪要窗口里的“打开麦克风”，知了就用 Mac 的麦克风听桌边的人说话，字幕、纪要和会议记录跟线上会议一样；电脑里的声音照常在听，电脑没声音时就只记桌边的人。同声传译念译文的时候麦克风暂时不听，不会把译文再记成别人的话。每次启动麦克风都是关着的。 有人在会议室、有人在线上时也是这一个按钮：线上的人从电脑声音听，桌边的人从麦克风听，两边各认各的语言，记在同一份会议记录里（macOS 14 和 15 上打开麦克风改为只听桌边）。扬声器放出来的线上声音会被麦克风再听到一遍，知了会测出扬声器的声音有没有传到麦克风：传到了，线上有人说话的那一会儿桌边先不听；戴耳机或用会议麦克风时不用避让，两边同时说话也都能记下；电脑在放音乐时也不避让。最后还会比一遍文字，跟电脑声音里刚说过的话几乎一样的那句不再记第二遍。 这样的会议里，每句话都标着是“现场”还是“线上”。外接麦克风中途被拔掉，知了改用剩下的麦克风并说一声；麦克风开着却一直没有声音，会先重开一次，还不行就在纪要窗口提示换一个。Windows 和 Linux 上也是同一个“打开麦克风”和同样的规则。 ### 同声传译 按住键盘右边的 `⌥` 键说话，对方在会议软件里就能直接听到翻译后的语音，打开同声传译时知了会自动把系统麦克风切到一键安装的虚拟驱动 BlackHole 2ch。填了 Ling API key 后可以用自然人声或用 8 到 30 秒录音克隆你自己的声音，不填也能用 Mac 自带语音。

### 会议记录 每场会议的双语文字记录、纪要和原始录音都保存在本机，会后在会议记录里就能回放录音，点一句的时间就从那里放，正在放的那句会亮起；还能按声音区分对方不同的说话人并在有 Ling key 时填上名字，认错了在实时纪要窗口里就能改名、合并或把某段话改给别人。会议软件挂断或 10 分钟没人说话时会自动结束并截掉空白，会后随时可以补生成纪要，或导出成 Markdown、Word 和 SRT 字幕。已有的录音或视频也能拖进会议记录窗口（或用“文件 › 导入录音或视频…”），在本机比实时快得多地转成一场双语记录，点时间就从那一句开始播放原文件。当时没听出是哪种语言的会议也会留下录音，选好语言就能重新转写。目前记录里的你只包含按住说话键说的话，会上直接开口的部分见[路线图](#路线图)。

## 隐私与权限 在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上，声音采集、语言识别、语音识别（Apple SpeechAnalyzer，macOS 14.4–15 上是 SFSpeechRecognizer 的本机模式）和会议录音全部在本机完成。会离开电脑的只有识别出来的文字（发去做翻译和生成纪要），以及填了 Ling API key 并按住说话键用同声传译时你说的那几句语音；语音模型下载太慢时如果你点了“先用 Ling 听”，模型装好之前的会议声音也会交给 Ling 识别；在“设置 › AI 服务”里把语音识别改成自建服务时，会议声音会发到你那台机器。不填 API key 时，实时字幕、翻译（走 Google 或退回 Apple 本机翻译，本机翻译只在 macOS 26 上有）、会议记录和同声传译都能正常用。实时纪要、一步语音翻译和声音克隆需要你自己的 Ling（蚂蚁集团的大模型服务）API key（配置方法见[下文](#配置-ling-api-key)），开一小时会大约花 0.15 到 1 元人民币，Ling 每月赠送 10 元额度，约够 10 到 50 小时会议。 Intel 版 Mac 以及 Windows、Linux 和 Android 版在云端识别：说话的声音分段发给 Ling 的 Ming（Windows、Linux、Android 也可换成 OpenRouter、ZenMux 等服务），所以必须填 AI 服务的 key；录音和会议记录同样只存在本机。 下面说的是 Mac 版。知了只在用到某项功能时才请求对应的权限，拒绝后其他功能照常可用。 | 权限 | 用来做什么 | 什么时候问 | 不给的话 | |---|---|---|---| | 录制系统声音（屏幕与系统录音） | 听 Mac 正在播放的声音来出字幕，不录屏幕，也不听知了自己的声音 | 新手引导第一步，或第一次开始听 | 字幕和纪要都用不了 | | 麦克风 | 按住说话键时录你说的话做同声传译；点了“打开麦克风”时听屋里的人 | 打开同声传译或第一次打开麦克风时 | 不能说话翻译，也不能听会议室 | | 输入监控 | 只用来判断右 `⌥` 是否被单独按下（只监听、不拦截、不记录别的按键） | 第一次用右 `⌥` 说话时 | 在设置里改成 `⌃`/`⌘` 组合键，就不需要这个权限 | | 管理员密码 | 安装虚拟麦克风 BlackHole 2ch，并重启系统音频服务 | 在引导或设置里点“安装”时，只问一次 | 不能让对方听到翻译，其余照常 | - **联网与虚拟麦克风**。只有翻译（`translate.googleapis.com`）、填了 key 后的 Ling / Ming（`api.ant-ling.com`）或你选的其他 AI 服务、下载 BlackHole 驱动和每天去 GitHub 检查一次新版本会联网。BlackHole 从官方下载已经过苹果公证的安装包，安装前会核对代码里写死的 SHA-256。 - **没有统计和自建服务器**。应用没有统计、没有埋点，也没有我们自己的服务器，诊断功能只把耗时和次数记在本机会议文件夹里。 - **本机数据位置**。会议记录、录音和纪要存在 `~/Library/Application Support/LiveSubs`。Ling key 和你录的声音样本只对当前系统账户可读，不进 Time Machine 备份，也不写进日志和导出文件。 - **共享屏幕看不到纪要窗口**。屏幕共享、录屏和截图都拍不到它，要录演示时可以打开“共享屏幕时让对方看到”。 ## 用到的模型 不填 Ling key 时全部由 Apple 本机模型加 Google 翻译完成，填了 key 后由 Ling 和 Ming 模型负责并支持失败自动退回。正在说的半句话一直用 Google 翻译；用自己的服务（“其他（兼容 OpenAI）”）时，可以在“设置 › AI 服务”打开“语音和文字只发给你的服务”，语音和文字就都不经过 Google。 | 功能 | 填了 Ling key | 不填 key / 退回 | |---|---|---| | 语音识别、语言识别 | Apple `SpeechAnalyzer` / `SpeechTranscriber`（本机）；macOS 14.4–15 是 `SFSpeechRecognizer`（本机，要打开听写） | 同左 | | 整句翻译 | Ling `Ling-3.1-flash`（可在“设置 › AI 服务”改为 `Ling-3.0-flash`） | Google 翻译 → Apple `Translation`（本机，仅 macOS 26） | | 正在说的半句话的翻译 | Google 翻译（不占 Ling 的频率额度；用自己的服务时可以关掉） | 无：只显示原文，说完一句换成整句翻译；连不上时暂停一分钟再试 | | 实时纪要、会后完整版 | Ling `Ling-3.1-flash`（同上设置） | 不可用 | | 检查 key 是否有效 | Ling `Ling-3.0-tiny`（只用一个 token） | — | | 同声传译：听懂并翻译你说的话 | Ming `Ming-3.0-audio-flash`，一步完成 | Apple 本机识别，再走上面的翻译链 | | 同声传译：对方听到的声音、声音克隆 | Ming `Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B` | Mac 自带语音（`AVSpeechSynthesizer`），不能克隆 | | 说话人识别（默认打开） | WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM 声纹模型，随 app 附带，本机运行（Core ML） | 同左 | ## 配置 Ling API key 1. 打开 [Ling 开放平台](https://chat.ant-ling.com/platform/api)，注册或登录。 2. 点创建令牌，复制以 `sk-` 开头的那串 key。 3. 在知了里打开设置里的 AI 服务，粘贴后点保存并检查，也可以直接粘贴到纪要窗口顶部的提示框里。知了会发一个只用一个 token 的请求确认 key 可用。 4. 同一页面可以选模型（默认 `Ling-3.1-flash`），每种语言用哪个 Ming 声音在同声传译设置里选。想移除 key，在同一页面点移除即可。 **注册不了 Ling？**可以在“设置 › AI 服务”右上角换成 OpenRouter、ZenMux、OpenAI，或填任何 OpenAI 兼容服务的地址（比如本机跑的模型）。实时纪要和整句翻译都能用，模型已经按效果和价格选好，也可以自己换；OpenRouter 和 ZenMux 还能用 Gemini 的自然人声做同传。一步语音翻译和声音克隆只有 Ling 有，其他服务下，Apple 芯片的 Mac 同传先在本机识别再翻译（Intel 版听和说都要 Ling）。每个服务的 key 各存一份，切换时不用重填。自己部署的模型（Ollama、vLLM、SGLang 等）按功能分开填：翻译和纪要、同传声音、语音识别各自可以接不同的机器，局域网里的地址也能用 http；检查时会真翻一句，模型先思考或太慢都会直说（Qwen3 这类模型知了会请它别思考）。Mac 的语音识别可以改交给你的 Qwen3-ASR、Whisper 等（默认仍在本机，连不上时自动换回）；Windows、Linux、Android 上“听对方”的模型也可以填单独的地址。Windows、Linux、Android 版也能换：在引导里点“用不了 Ling？”或在设置 › AI 服务里选，听对方也交给这家服务，字幕比 Ling 晚 1–2 秒。连不上或 key、模型有问题时，设置里会一步步说清坏在哪、怎么修：是没开代理、代理软件没接管系统代理，还是开了代理也不通（知了不会自己改代理，说明见网站的[设置页](https://cicada.indaloop.app/start/#proxy)）；用 OpenRouter 时余额快用完会提前提醒。 ## 系统要求与安装 ### Mac 需要 macOS 14.4 或更新版本（支持 Apple 芯片与 Intel）。Apple 芯片 Mac 在 macOS 26 上用新的本机语音识别，更准；14.4–15 上用系统较早的识别，要在系统设置 › 键盘里打开“听写”，并把要听的语言加进听写语言；Intel 版 Mac 则通过云端 Ming 模型识别语音，需要配置 Ling key。界面有中文、英文、日文和韩文，默认跟随系统语言，也可以在系统设置的语言与地区里单独给知了指定。 从 [Releases 页面](https://github.com/wquguru/cicada/releases/latest) 或 [官网](https://cicada.indaloop.app) 下载 `Cicada-<版本>-macOS-AppleSilicon.dmg`（Apple 芯片）或 `Cicada-<版本>-macOS-Intel.dmg`（Intel），打开后把知了拖进应用程序文件夹。应用目前是本地签名，还没有苹果公证（见[路线图](#路线图)），第一次打开被拦下时，去系统设置的隐私与安全性里点仍要打开。下载页同时提供 `checksums.txt`，可以用 `shasum -a 256 Cicada-*.dmg` 核对。有疑问可以去 X 找作者 [@wquguru](https://x.com/wquguru)。 打开后跟着首次引导开一个权限、听一段双人示例会议直接看字幕效果、接上 Ling key（也可以先跳过），要用同声传译时再装虚拟麦克风。之后有新版本时菜单栏图标会出现橙点，点一下就能更新，权限不会丢。

### Windows 需要 Windows 10 2004 或更新版本。下载 Windows 安装包（大多数电脑选 x64，骁龙笔记本选 ARM64），双击就装好，不用管理员权限；安装程序还没有代码签名，SmartScreen 拦下时点更多信息 › 仍要运行。打开就是主窗口，列着还差哪几步：接上 Ling key、放一段测试声音、看示例会议；同声传译要装免费的 VB-Cable 虚拟麦克风，引导会带你装。新版本在知了里提示，点一下就升级。 ### Linux 需要 Ubuntu 22.04 或 24.04 桌面版（x86_64 或 arm64）。下载 `Cicada-<版本>-Linux.tar.gz`，在终端里运行 `tar xzf Cicada-<版本>-Linux.tar.gz && cicada-linux/install.sh`，知了会出现在应用菜单里。同声传译会自己建一个“知了 麦克风”，不用装驱动。Linux 没法让窗口避开屏幕共享，纪要窗会一直标着“共享屏幕时此窗口可见”。会议录音要用 AAC 编码器，Ubuntu 默认没有：装了第三方媒体格式（比如 `ubuntu-restricted-extras`）后，“设置 › 通用 › 保存会议录音”才能打开，录音可以在会议记录里回放，点一句的时间就从那里放；没装时这个开关是灰的，其他功能照常。 ### Android 需要 Android 10 或更新版本。在手机上下载 `Cicada-<版本>-Android.apk` 打开安装，按提示允许安装未知应用；第一次打开悬浮字幕时，Android 15 起要先在应用信息里允许受限制的设置。Android 也能用和 Mac 相同的本机声纹模型按声音区分对方的说话人（说话人 1、2…），填了 Ling key 时还会填上名字。微信通话和会议 app 的声音系统不让录，这时开外放、改选“面对面”。 每个平台的安装包都能用 Releases 页面里的 `checksums.txt` 核对 SHA-256。 ## 路线图 按先后排，想要哪一项欢迎在 Issues 里说。 - **记录我的发言**，开会时持续听麦克风并做回声消除，把你直接开口说的话也记进文字记录和纪要。 - **正式签名与公证**，首次打开不再需要点仍要打开，AI key 也能放回系统钥匙串；Windows 安装程序也加上代码签名。 - **声纹识别**，在现有的说话人识别基础上，在本机记住常一起开会的人的声音，下次开会也能自动认出。 - **不用 key 也有纪要**，在支持的 Mac 上用 Apple 本机模型整理纪要。 - **Android 上架应用商店**，不用再从浏览器装 APK。 - **iPhone 和 iPad**，系统不允许采集其他 app 的声音，所以先做听会议室、面对面互译和会议记录。 每项的细节和取舍见 [docs/ROADMAP.zh-CN.md](docs/ROADMAP.zh-CN.md)。 ## 卸载 退出知了，去应用程序文件夹里把它拖进废纸篓即可。会议记录和录音都在 `~/Library/Application Support/LiveSubs` 文件夹里，不需要的话可以手动删掉。想清除软件设置可以运行： ```bash defaults delete com.wquguru.cicada ``` ## 开发 Mac 版从源码构建只需要安装 Xcode Command Line Tools（`xcode-select --install`），项目没有任何第三方依赖。在 macOS 27 上如果编译时报 `SwiftUIMacros` 缺失，说明这一版 Command Line Tools 不带 SwiftUI 的宏插件，安装完整的 Xcode 并运行 `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app` 即可。Windows、Linux、Android 的构建方法见 [windows/README.md](windows/README.md)、[linux/README.md](linux/README.md)、[android/README.md](android/README.md)。 ```bash scripts/build.sh # 编译开发版 → build/Cicada.app（名为 Cicada Dev，可与正式版同时运行） open build/Cicada.app scripts/package.sh # 打包正式版 DMG、zip 和 SHA-256 校验值 ``` 代码架构等说明写在 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 里。官网源码放在 `site/` 目录，由 `scripts/site.py` 生成。历次更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 或官网的[更新日志页](https://cicada.indaloop.app/changelog/)。 ## 开源协议 本项目采用 [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) 协议开源。同声传译用到的虚拟麦克风驱动 BlackHole 2ch 采用 GPL 协议，知了安装包里不打包它，在你点安装时直接从它的官方发布地址下载。随 app 附带的声纹模型是 [WeSpeaker](https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wespeaker) 在 VoxCeleb 上训练的 ResNet34-LM，采用 CC BY 4.0 协议，由 `scripts/convert-voiceprint.py` 转成 Core ML。

items.description: Blazing-fast native notes app for macOS & Windows. Rust + GPUI, local-first, compatible with Feishu/Lark DocxXML.
items.readme:
Quiet.md

A fast, quiet, local notes app.
Drawn natively with Rust + GPUI. Your notes stay on your computer, stored in the Feishu (Lark) DocxXML format.

English · 简体中文 · 日本語

 

Website · Download · Performance · Features · Contributing

> [!NOTE] > Quiet.md is in **beta** and changing quickly. If you hit a bug or have an idea, please [open an issue](https://github.com/s1dashu/quiet-md/issues) — or better, send a pull request. Linux support is experimental and currently built from source; see the [Linux instructions and validation limits](CONTRIBUTING.md#linux-experimental). ## Why Quiet.md **⚡ Fast, the native kind of fast.** The whole interface is drawn on the GPU by Rust and [GPUI](https://www.gpui.rs/). No WebView, no Electron. In a one-million-character document, typing, deleting and scrolling all stay under 6 ms per frame at P95. **🔒 Local-first. Your files are yours.** No account, no cloud, and nothing goes over the network by default (the optional update check aside). Your library is an ordinary folder on your computer, and each note is one XML file. Manage it with Git, iCloud or any sync tool you like; if you ever stop using Quiet.md, your files are still there. **📝 A full rich-text editor that speaks Feishu (Lark) DocxXML.** Notes are saved in the DocxXML format used by Feishu (Lark) Docs, so copy-paste, import and export keep their structure. Headings, to-dos, tables, columns, callouts, code, math, images and attachments — the blocks you reach for when writing documents are all there. ## Download

Markdown shortcuts such as `#`, `-`, `[]` and `>`, plus a `/` slash menu. - **Organizing**: a document tree, pinning, favorites, full-text search and a trash. - **Import and export**: import Markdown and Feishu (Lark) DocxXML; export Markdown and PDF, or print directly.
